task: T11: Plugin in a fresh project
method: Source copied byte-for-byte into a newly created minimal UE project outside the product and OneDrive; no prebuilt plugin binaries or product Data directory; engine plugins disabled by default and SQLiteCore/SQLiteSupport explicitly disabled.
limits: No UI panel or actor adapter is included; the registered tool descriptor has an empty widget-class path.
Generic JSON/geometry validation only: navigationChecked is false, so route reachability is not checked.
Non-layout JSON requires conversion to the layout contract; raw SQLite input is not supported.
Game target was compiled and linked, not cooked/packaged or run as a game.
Registry authentication/installation was not tested; root package pin is 1.0.0 while copied source is 1.1.1.
